# discord_sticker (Resource)

Manages a custom server sticker. Requires the Create Expressions permission, and Manage Expressions for stickers uploaded by others. Free sticker slots depend on the server's boost level.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_sticker" "wave" {
  server_id   = var.server_id
  name        = "Wave"
  description = "Wumpus waves hello"
  tags        = "wave"
  file        = filebase64("${path.module}/wave.png")
}

# With Terraform 1.11 or later, file_wo keeps the file out of state. Bump
# file_wo_version to upload a new file, which creates a new sticker.
resource "discord_sticker" "dance" {
  server_id       = var.server_id
  name            = "Dance"
  tags            = "dancer"
  file_wo         = filebase64("${path.module}/dance.gif")
  file_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Sticker name (2-30 characters).
- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).
- `tags` (String) Autocomplete and suggestion tags (1-200 characters). The Discord client uses the name of an emoji related to the sticker.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `audit_log_reason` (String) Reason recorded in the server's audit log for changes this resource makes, overriding the provider's `audit_log_reason`. Up to 512 characters. Changing only this argument updates state without calling Discord.
- `description` (String) Sticker description (2-100 characters).
- `file` (String) Sticker file as base64 (PNG, APNG, GIF or Lottie JSON, at most 512 KiB and 320x320 pixels, animations at most 5 seconds), e.g. `filebase64("sticker.png")`. Lottie stickers need the server feature `VERIFIED` or `PARTNERED`. Changing it uploads a new sticker. Stored in state; prefer `file_wo` on Terraform 1.11 or later. Exactly one of `file` and `file_wo` is required.
- `file_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Sticker file as base64 (PNG, APNG, GIF or Lottie JSON, at most 512 KiB and 320x320 pixels, animations at most 5 seconds), e.g. `filebase64("sticker.png")`. Lottie stickers need the server feature `VERIFIED` or `PARTNERED`. Write-only: the value is never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later and `file_wo_version`. Conflicts with `file`.
- `file_wo_version` (Number) Version of `file_wo`. Changing it uploads `file_wo` as a new sticker.

### Read-Only

- `available` (Boolean) Whether the sticker can be used. It may be false after the server loses boosts.
- `format_type` (String) File format Discord detected: `png`, `apng`, `lottie`, `gif`.
- `id` (String) Sticker ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = discord_sticker.wave
  identity = {
    server_id  = "234567890123456789"
    sticker_id = "567890123456789012"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).
- `sticker_id` (String) ID of the sticker.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import discord_sticker.wave <server_id>/<sticker_id>
```
